quadrants.TL: What are things? A house is a thing. Houses are things. A hat is a thing. Hats are things. Doors and windows are things. Tables and seats are things.
quadrants.TR: This is a man. This is a woman. This is a boy. This is a girl. Men and women and boys and girls are not things.They are persons. You are a person.
quadrants.BL: There are two persons in this room. They are a boy and a girl. The girl is at the door. The boy is at the window.
quadrants.BR: The girl will go to the window. She will be with the boy at the window. She will be with him at the window.

quadrants.TL: The girl is going to the window. Where was she? She was at the door.
quadrants.TR: She went to the window. Where is she now? She is at the window now. She is with the boy.
quadrants.BL: They are at the window together. She is with him at the window. He is with her at the window.
quadrants.BR: These books are together on the shelf. These books are not together.They are on the shelf, but they are not together.

quadrants.TL: The girl and the boy will go from the window.
quadrants.TR: They are going from the window.They were at the window.
quadrants.BL: They went from the window. She went with him and he went with her.
quadrants.BR: Now they are at the door together. The boy is with the girl at the door. She is at the door again.

quadrants.BL: Her eyes are open. She sees. They were shut. She did not see. She did not see me.
quadrants.BR: Her eyes are shut. They were open. She saw. What did she see? She saw me.

quadrants.BL: These are the pages of the book. These are the covers of the book. The pages are between the covers of the book.
quadrants.BR: These are the fingers of my hand. This finger is between these other two fingers of my hand.

quadrants.BL: The light is over the table. The dog is under the table.
quadrants.BR: This is a clock. It is on the wall. It is over the bookshelves. The bookshelves are under the clock.

quadrants.TR: These are his ears. Where are her ears? They are under her hair. Her hair is over her ears.
quadrants.BL: This is his head. This is his face. His eyes, his nose, and his mouth are parts of his face.
quadrants.BR: This is a clock. It has a face. This is the face of the clock.The clock has two hands, a long hand and a short hand.The long hand is at 5.The short hand is between 7 and 8.

quadrants.TL: A clock has a face. It has no nose. It has no eyes. It has no mouth.
quadrants.TR: It has no ears. It has no hair but it has a face. It has a face and two hands, the long hand and the short hand.
quadrants.BL: The long hand of the clock is between one and two. One is before two.Two is between one and three. Three is after two and two is after one.
quadrants.BR: I have this book in my hands. It was on the shelf with the other books. It was between the other two books before I took it from the shelf.

quadrants.TL: I have it in my hand. I am putting it between the other two books. Then it will be with the other books.
quadrants.TR: Now it is on the shelf again. It was in my hand. I had it in my hand. It is not in my hand.Where is it?
quadrants.BL: This is a room. What do you see in the room? Do you see the floor and three walls of the room? Do you see them?
quadrants.BR: Do you see a door and two windows? Is one of the windows open? Is the other window shut? Do you see two seats and the bookshelves between them? Do you see the clock over the bookshelves? Yes. I see them. These things are in the room.The room is in a house.

quadrants.TR: He has a body. She has a body. All men and women and boys and girls have bodies. This baby has a body.
quadrants.BL: This dog has a body. This is his tail. This is his body. He has four legs and a head and a tail. He has no arms or hands, but he has feet. His head, his body, his legs, and his tail are parts of a dog.
quadrants.BR: This is a dog’s head. Which is his mouth? Which are his eyes? Which are his ears? Which is his nose?

quadrants.TR: This is a leg. This is a knee. It is part of a leg. This part of a leg is its knee. Our legs are parts of us.
quadrants.BL: This is a neck. It is a part of a man. It is between his head and his body. The part which is between his head and his body is his neck.
quadrants.BR: This is a man’s head. This is his chin. It is under his mouth. It is a part of his face. The part which is under his mouth is his chin.

quadrants.TL: This is a man’s body. The part which is between his head, his arms, and his legs is his body.
quadrants.TR: This is his body. This part of him is his chest. This is a chest of drawers.
quadrants.BL: This man has his finger on his chin. This man has his hand on his chest.
quadrants.BR: This baby is on his hands and knees. This baby is on his hands and feet. This baby is on his knees. This baby is on his feet.

quadrants.TL: Who is this? He is John Smith. His name is John Smith. Where is John Smith? He is at the door of his house.
quadrants.TR: He has his hand in his pocket.
quadrants.BL: He is taking a key from his pocket.
quadrants.BR: This is a key. These are other keys.

quadrants.TL: He will put the key in the lock of the door.
quadrants.TR: He is putting the key in the lock.
quadrants.BL: He is giving a turn to the key.
quadrants.BR: He is giving a push to the door. The door is open now.

quadrants.TL: John took the key from the lock. He is putting it in his pocket. He will go into his house.
quadrants.TR: He is going into the house.
quadrants.BL: He went into the house. He is in the house. The door is shut.
quadrants.BR: This is a room in the house. Is John in the room? No, he is not. He will come into the room.

quadrants.TL: He is coming into the room. He will go to the table.
quadrants.TR: Mr. Smith came into the room. He went to the table.
quadrants.BL: Is Ms. Smith in the room? No, she is not.
quadrants.BR: She is in the house but she is not in the room. She is in another room in the house. Who is this? This is Mary Smith. She is Ms. Smith. Her name is Mary Smith.

quadrants.TL: This is one of the doors of the room. This is the other door.
quadrants.TR: This is one of the windows of the room. This is another window. And this is another window. One window is open. The other windows are shut.
quadrants.BL: This is one of my hands. It is my left hand. This is my other hand. It is my right hand.
quadrants.BR: This is one of my fingers. This is my left thumb. These are the other fingers of my left hand.

quadrants.TL: Ms. Smith is not in the room. She went out of the room. She went through this door.
quadrants.TR: Mr. Smith is in the room. He came into the room. He came through this door.
quadrants.BL: Mr. Smith is putting his hat on the table. He will go out of the room through this door.
quadrants.BR: He put his hat on the table. It is on the table now. He went out of the room through this door.

quadrants.TL: Mary is coming into the room.
quadrants.TR: She is going to the table.
quadrants.BL: She will see the hat.
quadrants.BR: She sees it.

quadrants.TL: She saw it. When did she see it? She saw it after she went to the table.
quadrants.TR: What is that?
quadrants.BL: John’s hat!
quadrants.BR: What is that? John’s hat!

quadrants.TL: She will take the hat in her hand.
quadrants.TR: She is taking it.
quadrants.BL: She took it in her hand. She is going out of the room. She has the hat in her hand.
quadrants.BR: She went out of the room with John’s hat.

quadrants.TL: She is in another room now. She came into this room through this door. She has the hat with her.
quadrants.TR: What are these? They are hooks. That is another hat. It is on a hook.
quadrants.BL: She will put John’s hat on a hook. She will put it on a hook with the other hat.
quadrants.BR: She put it on the hook. Now it is with the other hat. The other hat is one of Mary’s hats.

quadrants.TL: John is coming into the room again.
quadrants.TR: He came into the room. He went to the table. He is there now.
quadrants.BL: The hat is not on the table.
quadrants.BR: He is saying, Where is my hat? I put it on the table.

quadrants.TL: “Where is my hat? It is not on my head. It isn’t here.”
quadrants.TR: “It isn’t (is not) here.”
quadrants.BL: “Where is it? Mary, where is my hat? Where are you, Mary?”
quadrants.BR: Here is Mary. She is coming into the room. She says,“Here I am.”

quadrants.TL: “Where is your hat?”
quadrants.TR: “You put it on the table. It was on the table.”
quadrants.BL: “I took it. I put it in the other room.”
quadrants.BR: “It is on a hook there.You will see it there.”

quadrants.TL: John says,“I will get my hat.”
quadrants.TR: He is getting it.
quadrants.BL: Did he get it? Yes. He has it.
quadrants.BR: He went out of the room.

quadrants.TL: When he saw the hat he took it off the hook.
quadrants.TR: He came into the room again with the hat in his hands. He got it.
quadrants.BL: He is giving the hat to Mary.
quadrants.BR: See what is in the hat, Mary!

quadrants.TL: What is in the hat? Mary will see.
quadrants.TR: What is she taking from the hat?
quadrants.BL: What is that in her hand? It is money.
quadrants.BR: Do you see? She sees.

quadrants.TL: What does she see? One thousand dollars. The money is in her hand. It was in the hat.
quadrants.TR: Where was the hat? It was on the table. What did she see? She saw the hat. She did not see the money.
quadrants.BL: She put the hat in the other room. John went there and got it. Who got it? John did.
quadrants.BR: Does she see the money now? Yes, she sees it. Oh John! Where did you get it?

quadrants.TL: I was in the street. I was coming here.
quadrants.TR: The wind came. It took my hat off.
quadrants.BL: I went after my hat.
quadrants.BR: When I took it up, there was this money.

quadrants.TL: The money was under the hat. The hat was over the money.
quadrants.TR: The wind came. My hat went up. When the wind came, my hat went up. UP
quadrants.BL: The hat came down again. UP DOWN
quadrants.BR: It was over the money. The money was under the hat.

quadrants.TL: What is Mary doing? She is taking things from a drawer. What are those things in the drawer?
quadrants.TR: They are knives, forks and spoons. knife fork spoon The drawer has knives, forks and spoons in it.
quadrants.BL: Mary has a knife, a fork and a spoon in her right hand.
quadrants.BR: She took them from the drawer. She will put them on the table. These are drawers. One of them is open. The other two drawers are shut.

quadrants.TL: Mary is getting the soup. These are plates of soup.
quadrants.TR: John is taking the seats to the table.
quadrants.BL: Mary is in her seat at the table.
quadrants.BR: John is in his seat. They are in their seats at the table.

quadrants.TL: Now they are taking their soup. They have their spoons in their hands.
quadrants.TR: “John is saying to Mary, “I took the hat up.” “Mary is saying to John, “Where did the money “come from?”
quadrants.BL: John said, “I saw it there under the hat.” Mary said, “But who put it there?”
quadrants.BR: John said, “Nobody put it there.The money was there and the wind came and put the hat down over the money.” Nobody = no man or woman or boy or girl or baby.

quadrants.TL: What will we do What will with our you do? money?
quadrants.TR: I will get a new dress. This dress is new. This dress is old.
quadrants.BL: And what will you get?
quadrants.BR: I will get a new pipe. This pipe is new. This pipe is old.

quadrants.TL: Mary is getting the new dress. She is in a store. The other woman has two dresses in her hands.
quadrants.TR: This is the store. CLOTHING STORE Dresses and hats and shoes are in the window of the store.
quadrants.BL: These are shoes. They are women’s shoes. These are stockings.
quadrants.BR: These are gloves. Dresses and stockings and shoes and gloves are clothing.

quadrants.TL: This is a tree. This is a branch of the tree. An apple is on this branch. It is over the girl’s head. She will take the apple from the branch. She will put her hand up.
quadrants.TR: She put her hand up. She took the apple. It is in her hand. She took the apple which is in her hand. She has it in her hand. She is putting it in her basket.
quadrants.BL: She put it in her basket. She had it in her hand before she put it in her basket. It was on the branch before she put her hand up and took it.
quadrants.BR: After she took the apple she put it in the basket. Then she put her basket down.The apple was up on the tree. Now it is down in the basket.

quadrants.TL: When was the apple on the branch? When was it over her head? It was on the branch before she took it. It was on the branch then.
quadrants.TR: When did she take it? She took it after she put her hand up. She took it then.
quadrants.BL: When did she put it in the basket? She put it in the basket after she took it from the branch.
quadrants.BR: When did she have the apple in her hand? She had it in her hand after she took it from the branch and before she put it in the basket.

quadrants.TL: This is a box. This is the front of the box.
quadrants.TR: This is a house. This is the front of the house. This is the front door.
quadrants.BL: This is the back of the box. And these are the sides of the box.
quadrants.BR: This is a coat. This is the front of the coat.

quadrants.TL: These are the arms of the coat. These are the sides of the coat.
quadrants.TR: And this is the back of the coat.
quadrants.BL: These are a man’s arms. These are his sides.
quadrants.BR: And this is his back.

quadrants.TL: Who is this? This is Ms. Smith. She is Mary Smith. “Mary Smith”is her name.
quadrants.TR: What is that? What is in her hands? It is a tray. She has a tray in her hands.
quadrants.BL: She will put the tray on the table.
quadrants.BR: She is putting the tray on the table.

quadrants.TL: She put the tray on the table. It was in her hands. It is on the table now.
quadrants.TR: Here is the tray. What are these things on the tray?
quadrants.BL: These are glasses. What are these? They are forks. What is this? It is a knife. What are these? They are two other knives.
quadrants.BR: What are these? They are spoons. What is this? It is another spoon. What is this? It is a plate. These are three other plates.

quadrants.TL: Ms. Smith is taking a knife and fork off the tray. She has them in her hands.
quadrants.TR: She is putting them on the table.
quadrants.BL: Now she is putting the plates on the table.
quadrants.BR: She put the knives and forks and spoons and plates and glasses on the table. She put these things on the table.

quadrants.TL: Mary Smith will go from the table to the door.
quadrants.TR: She is going to the door. The door is shut.
quadrants.BL: She went out of the room. The door is open now. It was shut.
quadrants.BR: Mary Smith is not in the room. She was in the room. She went out of the room.

quadrants.TL: What is this? It is a knife. What is this? What is this? What is this? What are these?
quadrants.TR: What is this? What is this? What is this? What is this?
quadrants.BL: What are these? What is this? What is this?
quadrants.BR: What is this? What are these things?

quadrants.TL: Mary is making soup. This is a plate of soup. She will make the soup from milk and potatoes.
quadrants.TR: These are potatoes. This is a bottle of milk. It is cow’s milk. This is a cow.
quadrants.BL: Cows are animals. These are some other animals. a pig a sheep a horse
quadrants.BR: We get milk from cows. Mary is putting some milk in a cup. The milk is going into the cup.

quadrants.TL: Mary has a potato in her hand. She is taking its skin off with a knife.
quadrants.TR: We get potatoes from the roots of a plant. Here they are in the earth. We get them up with a fork.
quadrants.BL: This is a plant. This is its flower. These are its leaves. These are its fruit. This is a branch. This is its stem. These are its roots.
quadrants.BR: These are roots of other plants.

quadrants.TL: Mary is making the soup.
quadrants.TR: This is the pot. This is the cover of the pot. She will make the soup in this pot.
quadrants.BL: She put the potatoes in the pot. The water in the pot is boiling. This is steam.
quadrants.BR: This is a flame. The pot is over the flame. The flame is under the pot.

quadrants.TL: This water is boiling. It is giving off steam. The heat of the flame is making it give off steam.
quadrants.TR: Ice is solid. This is ice. Water is a liquid. This is water.
quadrants.BL: This is a tray. It is a tray of ice. Ice is cold.
quadrants.BR: The room is warm. The heat of the flame is making the room warm. The things in the room are warm. Ice is not warm. It is cold.

quadrants.TL: This is a bird. It is on a tree. The other birds are not on the tree. They are in the air.
quadrants.TR: This is a plane. It is in the air. It is an airplane. It is going through the air. These are airplanes.
quadrants.BL: We take in air through our mouths and through our noses. The air comes in.Then it goes out.That is a breath. in out one breath in out two breaths in out
quadrants.BR: The air is coming out. It is warm. When it comes out it is warm. Put your hand here.Your breath is warm.

quadrants.TL: The room is warm. The water in the pot is very warm. It is boiling. 212° 100°
quadrants.TR: The air over the flame is very warm. It goes up. The air under the flame is not very warm. It goes up to the flame.
quadrants.BL: This is the icebox. It has ice in it. The air in the icebox is cold. This is These are milk. eggs.
quadrants.BR: This is the icebox. Mary keeps the milk in the icebox. She keeps it in the cold air. The air in the icebox is cold. The cold air keeps the milk cold.

quadrants.TL: This is a clock. A clock is an instrument for measuring time.
quadrants.TR: This is an instrument for measuring heat. Very warm Warm Cold Very cold
quadrants.BL: This is a measure. It is a yard measure. There are three feet in a yard. There are twelve inches in a foot.
quadrants.BR: This is Mary’s foot. These are her feet. This is John’s foot. It is ten inches long.

quadrants.TL: The walls and floor of the icebox are thick. This is a thin line. This is a thick line.
quadrants.TR: Warm Cold Warm air air air The thick walls keep the heat of the room out of the icebox. They keep the heat from the milk. The cold air in the icebox keeps the milk good.
quadrants.BL: John is having a drink. He is having a drink of milk from a glass. The milk is good. John is happy.
quadrants.BR: This milk is not good. It is bad. John is not happy.

quadrants.TL: This is meat. Mary keeps the meat in the icebox.
quadrants.TR: This is bread. Mary does not keep the bread in the icebox. She keeps it in a bread-box.
quadrants.BL: This is cheese. We make cheese from milk. We get milk from cows.
quadrants.BR: This is butter. We make butter from milk. Mary keeps the butter with the milk in the icebox. She keeps the cheese there.

quadrants.TL: These are apples. These are oranges. Apples and oranges are fruit. Does Mary keep the fruit in the icebox?
quadrants.TR: What is the time? The time is five (5:00). It is five. Mary will make the soup.
quadrants.BL: What is the time? It’s five-thirty (5:30). Mary is making the soup. The potatoes are in the pot.The water in the pot is boiling.
quadrants.BR: It is five-forty (5:40). Mary has a fork in her hand. She is putting the fork into the potatoes.

quadrants.TL: The potatoes are hard. The fork does not go into them.
quadrants.TR: It is five-fifty (5:50). Mary is putting the fork in again. She is doing it again.
quadrants.BL: The potatoes are soft. The fork goes into them.
quadrants.BR: She is taking them out of the pot and putting them on a plate.

quadrants.TL: The potatoes are on the plate. They were in the pot. They were hard. They are soft now.
quadrants.TR: Mary is crushing them with a fork. They are not hard now. They are soft.
quadrants.BL: Bread is soft. Meat is soft.
quadrants.BR: Glass is hard. Butter is soft.

quadrants.TL: John has a bit of cheese in his fingers.
quadrants.TR: He is putting the bit of cheese in his mouth.
quadrants.BL: Now it is between his teeth. This is his mouth. This is a tooth. These are teeth.
quadrants.BR: The cheese is not soft. It is hard. John’s teeth do not go into the cheese.

quadrants.TL: Mary put the potatoes and the milk and other things into the pot. This is salt.
quadrants.TR: She put the pot over a low flame. She put the cover on the pot. The low flame is under the pot.
quadrants.BL: This flame is low. This flame is high.
quadrants.BR: This building is high. This building is low.

quadrants.TL: What is the time? It is six (6:00). Mary is tasting the soup. It has a good taste. The soup is ready.
quadrants.TR: Now she is putting the soup in the plates. It was in the pot. Now it is in the plates.
quadrants.BL: She made the soup. She put it in the plates. She took them to the table.
quadrants.BR: The plates are on the table. The soup is ready. It is good soup. Mary made it.

quadrants.TL: Soup, potatoes, milk, meat, bread, butter, cheese, apples, oranges are food. They are different sorts of food.
quadrants.TR: An apple An orange Apples and oranges are different sorts of fruit.
quadrants.BL: These are different sorts of glasses. These are different sorts of boxes.
quadrants.BR: Glasses and boxes and fingers and dresses and flames are things. They are different sorts of things.

quadrants.TL: Cows and sheep and pigs and horses and goats are animals. They are different sorts of animals.
quadrants.TR: These are different sorts of plants. This is the leaf of one sort of plant. This is the leaf of another sort of plant.
quadrants.BL: These are the same. These are different. These are the same. These are different.
quadrants.BR: These plates are the same. These plates are different. These glasses are the same. These are different.

quadrants.TL: Here are a woman and a boy. The boy is the woman’s son. She is his mother. He is her son.
quadrants.TR: Here are a woman and a girl. The girl is the woman’s daughter. The woman is her mother.
quadrants.BL: Here are a man and his son. The man is the father of the boy. He is the boy’s father.
quadrants.BR: Here are a man and his daughter. He is the father of the girl. He is the girl’s father. She is his daughter.

quadrants.TL: The boy is the brother of the girl. He is the girl’s brother. He is her brother.
quadrants.TR: The girl is the sister of the boy. She is the boy’s sister. She is his sister.
quadrants.BL: This man and woman have two sons and three daughters.
quadrants.BR: This boy has one brother and three sisters. This girl has two brothers and two sisters. They are a family of seven (7).

quadrants.TL: Here are Ms. Smith, her daughter Jane, and her son Tom. They are at the table. They are having their potato soup.
quadrants.TR: Potato soup is a thick soup. It is not clear. Thick soup and clear soup are two different sorts of soup.
quadrants.BL: This water is clear. When a liquid is clear we see through it. Milk is not a clear liquid. We do not see through it.
quadrants.BR: The air is clear. I see the mountains. When the air is not clear I do not see them.

quadrants.TL: This soup is clear. We see the spoon through it. Potato soup is a thick soup.We do not see the spoon through it.
quadrants.TR: Who is this? This is Mary Smith. She made the soup. This is Mary who made the soup.
quadrants.BL: This is the soup. Mary made it. This is the soup which Mary made.
quadrants.BR: This is the milk. Mary put it in the soup. This is the milk which Mary put in the soup.

quadrants.TL: This is a spoon. It is in my hand. This is a spoon which is in my hand.
quadrants.TR: That is a glass of water. It is on the table. That is a glass of water which is on the table.
quadrants.BL: This is a bone. It was in the dog’s mouth. This is a bone which was in the dog’s mouth.
quadrants.BR: This is a dog. He had the bone. This is the dog who had it.
